avocado_toast.name: Avocado Toast
avocado_toast.health_notes: Rich in heart-healthy monounsaturated oleic acid, potassium, and dietary fiber. Excellent for cardiovascular wellness.
avocado_toast.portion_advice: A standard 150g-200g serving on whole-grain sourdough provides sustained satiety without blood sugar spikes.

healthier_alternatives.name: Avocado Toast on Sprouted Grain Bread with Poached Egg
healthier_alternatives.reason: Boosts high-quality complete protein by +6g and lowers glycemic index.

healthier_alternatives.name: Cottage Cheese & Sliced Avocado Toast
healthier_alternatives.reason: Reduces total fat while increasing protein to 15g per slice.

grilled_salmon.name: Grilled Salmon Bowl
grilled_salmon.health_notes: Outstanding source of EPA/DHA Omega-3 fatty acids, lean bioavailable protein, and B-vitamins for brain and heart vitality.
grilled_salmon.portion_advice: Ideal post-workout or dinner meal. 150g of salmon fillet paired with 100g brown rice and 70g vegetables offers balanced macronutrients.

healthier_alternatives.name: Salmon with Quinoa & Steamed Asparagus
healthier_alternatives.reason: Replaces starchy rice with low-glycemic complete amino acid quinoa.

healthier_alternatives.name: Salmon with Cauliflower Rice Bowl
healthier_alternatives.reason: Cuts carbohydrates by 65% for a strict low-carb or keto-friendly meal.

margherita_pizza.name: Margherita Pizza
margherita_pizza.health_notes: Moderate calorie density with good calcium from mozzarella and lycopene from cooked tomato sauce, but higher in sodium and refined wheat carbohydrates.
margherita_pizza.portion_advice: Limit to 1-2 medium slices (approx 200g) and pair with a crisp leafy green side salad to moderate glycemic impact.

healthier_alternatives.name: Thin-Crust Cauliflower Base Margherita
healthier_alternatives.reason: Reduces refined flour carbohydrates by 50% and lowers calories by 70 kcal per slice.

healthier_alternatives.name: Whole Wheat Thin Crust Pizza with Light Mozzarella
healthier_alternatives.reason: Adds +3g dietary fiber and cuts saturated fat by 30%.

berry_oatmeal.name: Berry Oatmeal Bowl
berry_oatmeal.health_notes: High in beta-glucan soluble fiber known to lower LDL cholesterol, coupled with polyphenol anthocyanins from fresh blueberries and raspberries.
berry_oatmeal.portion_advice: A standard 250g bowl provides smooth, sustained energy for 3-4 hours without insulin spikes.

healthier_alternatives.name: Berry Oatmeal with Chia Seeds & Whey/Plant Protein
healthier_alternatives.reason: Boosts protein from 9g to 22g and adds 4g Omega-3 ALA.

healthier_alternatives.name: Overnight Oats with Unsweetened Almond Milk
healthier_alternatives.reason: Lower lactose and zero added refined sugars.

chicken_caesar_salad.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
chicken_caesar_salad.health_notes: Lean white chicken meat provides all 9 essential amino acids with crisp romaine supplying vitamins A and K. Caesar dressing contributes the bulk of fat and sodium.
chicken_caesar_salad.portion_advice: A generous 280g serving is satisfying as a complete meal. Ask for dressing on the side to manage fat intake.

healthier_alternatives.name: Chicken Caesar with Greek Yogurt Dressing
healthier_alternatives.reason: Cuts fat by 60% while adding +4g protein per serving.

healthier_alternatives.name: Chicken Caesar with Crispy Chickpeas instead of Croutons
healthier_alternatives.reason: Replaces refined croutons with complex fiber and resistant starch.

chocolate_cake.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
chocolate_cake.health_notes: High caloric density and concentrated refined sugars and saturated fats. Best enjoyed mindfully as an occasional treat.
chocolate_cake.portion_advice: A modest 60g-80g slice is recommended. Pairing with a hot unsweetened espresso or fresh berries helps balance sweetness.

healthier_alternatives.name: Dark Chocolate Avocado Mousse (70%+ Cacao)
healthier_alternatives.reason: Provides antioxidant flavonoids and healthy fats with 60% less refined sugar.

healthier_alternatives.name: Flourless Black Bean Protein Brownie
healthier_alternatives.reason: Adds 6g fiber and 8g protein per serving with natural stevia/monk fruit sweetening.

cheeseburger.name: Classic Cheeseburger
cheeseburger.health_notes: High in protein, zinc, and bioavailable heme iron, but also elevated in sodium and saturated animal fat.
cheeseburger.portion_advice: One single-patty burger (200g-220g). Skip heavy mayo and pair with a side salad instead of deep-fried fries.

healthier_alternatives.name: Grilled Turkey Burger on Whole Wheat Bun
healthier_alternatives.reason: Reduces saturated fat by 45% while preserving 28g lean protein.

healthier_alternatives.name: Lettuce-Wrapped Lean Beef Burger
healthier_alternatives.reason: Eliminates 140 calories and 25g refined carbohydrates from the bun.

spaghetti_bolognese.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
spaghetti_bolognese.health_notes: Balanced comfort dish with slow-cooked tomato rich in lycopene and savory ground meat providing B12.
spaghetti_bolognese.portion_advice: A 250g-300g portion cooked al-dente provides a lower glycemic response than overcooked pasta.

healthier_alternatives.name: Zucchini Noodles (Zoodles) Bolognese
healthier_alternatives.reason: Replaces wheat pasta with zucchini, cutting calories by 60%.

healthier_alternatives.name: Edamame or Lentil Pasta Bolognese
healthier_alternatives.reason: Doubles the protein to 24g and triples dietary fiber to 9g.

sushi_roll.name: Salmon Avocado Sushi Roll
sushi_roll.health_notes: Nutrient-dense with fresh salmon delivering omega-3 fats, seaweed (nori) supplying iodine and minerals.
sushi_roll.portion_advice: A standard 6 to 8-piece roll (approx 200g-220g). Dip lightly in low-sodium soy sauce to avoid excess salt.

healthier_alternatives.name: Brown Rice or Cauliflower Rice Sushi
healthier_alternatives.reason: Enhances fiber and eliminates refined sushi seasoning sugars.

healthier_alternatives.name: Salmon Sashimi with Cucumber Salad
healthier_alternatives.reason: Zero refined white rice, maximizes pure protein and omega-3s.

greek_yogurt_parfait.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
greek_yogurt_parfait.health_notes: Strained Greek yogurt provides active live probiotics for gut microbiome health and high-casein protein.
greek_yogurt_parfait.portion_advice: 200g-250g makes a protein-packed breakfast or mid-afternoon recovery snack.

healthier_alternatives.name: 0% Fat Greek Yogurt with Hemp Seeds & Fresh Berries
healthier_alternatives.reason: Lowers saturated fat to zero and adds plant-based omega-3s.

vegetable_stir_fry.name: Tofu & Vegetable Stir Fry
vegetable_stir_fry.health_notes: Vibrant rainbow of bell peppers, broccoli, carrots, and snap peas delivering immense vitamin C, phytonutrients, and isoflavones from firm tofu.
vegetable_stir_fry.portion_advice: Generous 300g portion can be eaten guilt-free with minimal calorie footprint.

healthier_alternatives.name: Stir Fry with Liquid Aminos instead of Regular Soy Sauce
healthier_alternatives.reason: Cuts sodium content by 40%.

french_fries.name: Crispy French Fries
french_fries.health_notes: Potatoes are naturally rich in potassium and vitamin C, but deep frying absorbs refined oils and elevates advanced glycation end-products (AGEs).
french_fries.portion_advice: Share a medium portion (approx 60-70g per person) or choose air-fried alternatives.

healthier_alternatives.name: Air-Fried Sweet Potato Wedges with Sea Salt & Paprika
healthier_alternatives.reason: Provides 300% daily Vitamin A, 65% less oxidized oil, and lower glycemic load.

healthier_alternatives.name: Roasted Zucchini or Carrot Fries
healthier_alternatives.reason: Cuts calories by 75% and provides natural prebiotic dietary fibers.
